name: John Cleves Symmes

updates.occupation: Delegate to the Continental Congress from New Jersey; judge; Northwest Territory pioneer (Symmes Purchase)

bioAdditions: Continental Congress delegate from New Jersey and later a pioneer of the Northwest Territory; father-in-law of President William Henry Harrison and great-grandfather of President Benjamin Harrison (S1). He is an in-law, not a blood relative of John; the blood line runs through his wife Anna Tuthill.
